items.item:
9. A09-1, A09-7: A `read` whose connection is refused before the first byte of the request is
   written, and a `read` whose connection drops after the request was written,
   each conclude `service_unreachable`, and no second request is sent.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a09_read_unsent_or_unanswered_unreachable]
statements: A09-7: read AND (not_sent OR no_answer OR 5xx) -> service_unreachable

verdicts.why: The refused-before-send case is detected as service_unreachable with zero received requests, while the dropped-after-request case is detected as service_unreachable with exactly one received request. The final request and trace counts confirm that neither attempt caused a second request.
